lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zr6Nb4Co2 (reduced formula Zr3Nb2Co) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers with 8 Zr neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement, while Nb centers have 10 neighbors (4 Co, 6 Zr) and Zr centers have 12 neighbors (4 Co, 4 Nb, 4 Zr) in a close-packed-like arrangement. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 12 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Co and Nb polyhedra, plus corner- and edge-sharing between Co and Zr polyhedra.
